articles.title: How high inflation became a 'fact of life' in the U.S.
articles.description: U.S. inflation has stayed elevated for years, raising concern at the Federal Reserve that consumers may come to expect stubbornly high prices.

articles.title: Consumer prices rose 3.7% annually in September as gas prices skyrocket
articles.description: The consumer price index was expected to increase 0.6% in September on a monthly basis and 3.6% from a year ago, according to the Dow Jones consensus forecast.

articles.title: 'Godzilla El Niño' is wreaking havoc with Philippine central bank's inflation forecasts
articles.description: The Philippine central bank is running policy scenarios for a severe El Niño on top of the oil shock, with inflation at a three-year high.

articles.title: The latest inflation data is expected to show price increases are accelerating
articles.description: Economists expect the consumer price index for September to rise 0.6% on the month and 3.6% year over year.

articles.title: In charts: How one of the world's biggest economies got trapped by debt
articles.description: France opens debate on its 2027 budget as high deficits, rising debt and student protests intensify pressure on lawmakers.

articles.title: World Bank jobs council urges 'crisis-era' employment support measures as IMF warns of AI ‘tsunami’
articles.description: IMF Chief Kristalina Georgieva warned AI is hitting the global labor market like a “slow-moving tsunami,” with young workers entering the job market the most exposed.

articles.title: IMF warns bond yields could see a 'disorderly' spike as debt, inflation risks worsen
articles.description: The IMF says risks in the government bond market have worsened and that yields could jump sharply and disorderly.

articles.title: IMF sees milder global slowdown as AI boom offsets war hit — warns resilience is nearing limits
articles.description: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%, warning that resilience is tested by energy constraints and looming fiscal risks.

articles.title: Nobel prize in economics awarded to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford
articles.description: The U.S. economists were awarded for work that underpins the models used by central banks and governments to stabilize the economy.

articles.title: India’s retail inflation jumps to 5.54% in September, above estimates
articles.description: India inflations jumps for the 11-straight month, raising prospects of a further interest rate hike

articles.title: Americans' debt problems are flashing a warning not seen since the Great Recession
articles.description: Researchers found that while wealth disparities narrowed somewhat, the ability to meet debt payments deteriorated significantly.

articles.title: Treasury's Bessent hires Trump's controversial former Fed board pick, Judy Shelton, as advisor
articles.description: Shelton's controversial economic ideas led the Senate to block her nomination to the Fed. Now she's going to be a counselor to the Treasury secretary.

articles.title: Inflation on many everyday items was entirely due to tariffs, NY Fed says
articles.description: Tariffs added 2.9 percentage points to inflation in 67 categories of goods by February 2026, researchers at the New York Federal Reserve found.

articles.title: Inflation fears on the rise as one-year outlook in Fed survey hits highest level since May 2023
articles.description: The Survey of Consumer Expectations indicated that the median outlook for inflation over the next 12 months rose to 3.9%.

articles.title: ICE came to town and left behind weakened economies
articles.description: Research links ICE enforcement surges to lasting declines in local spending, foot traffic and jobs. In Minneapolis, businesses are still recovering.

articles.title: India’s central bank hikes rates for the first time since 2023 as inflation risks build
articles.description: HSBC and Goldman Sachs expect the RBI to raise interest rates in December as well.

articles.title: Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva
articles.description: Kristalina Georgieva warns that the technology lifting growth hopes is also pushing up inflation and yields, just as public debt levels rose.

articles.title: World Bank warns of AI concentration risks as it lifts East Asia and Pacific growth outlook to 4.5%
articles.description: The World Bank now expects the region to grow 4.5% this year, but flagged that trade growth outside AI-related goods has been "weak or negative."

articles.title: Trade deficit hits $105.6 billion, widest since just before Trump tariffs enacted last year
articles.description: That marked a 13.7% jump from July and was ahead of the Dow Jones consensus estimate for $102 billion.

articles.title: The 2029 tipping point: Western populations are about to start shrinking, piling pressure on public finances
articles.description: Moody's predicts that the world's aging populations will have fundamental impacts on the global economy and lead to difficult policy decisions.

articles.title: Men are losing ground in the labor market. Here's why
articles.description: Women outnumbered men in the workforce for eight straight months as of September, according to one analysis.

articles.title: Labor market faltered in September as jobs increased by just 29,000, unemployment rate rose to 4.2%
articles.description: Nonfarm payrolls rose by just 29,000 in September, well below the 84,000 forecast, and the unemployment rate rose to 4.2%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics said.

articles.title: The September jobs report will be released Friday. Here's what to expect
articles.description: Wall Street is looking for job growth of 84,000 to close out the summer.

articles.title: Fed’s preferred gauge showed core inflation at 3.0% in August, much lighter than expected

articles.title: Private sector jobs rose by 90,000 in September, better than expected, ADP reports
articles.description: Private job creation picked up in September after a brief slowdown.

articles.title: The Fed's main inflation measure will be released Wednesday. Here's what to expect

articles.title: Consumer optimism slides to lowest since 2014 as fears escalate over rising prices and jobs

articles.title: America's Canadian import restrictions come into force. Here are the products barred from entry

articles.title: Australia says more hikes not off the table after raising rates to 15-year high

articles.title: China posts weakest industrial profit growth this year, expanding 4.2% in August
